Plan section 7.5: "Demote (pre-registered, H7): within-operator split-half distance >= between-operator distance for > half of pairs -> atlas reported noise-dominated, descriptive only." issue2569_atlas.py persists the ingredients (per-row floor cosines, per-pair raw cosines) but computes no within-vs-between comparison, no majority fraction, and no noise_dominated verdict; a grep for noise.domin|demote|H7 across every issue2569 script returns zero hits, figures included. So the section-7.5 disposition falls to interpretation-time judgment, which is exactly what pre-registration exists to remove. Two aggravators: floors are stored as COSINES under key "floor" while the predicate is phrased in DISTANCES (a downstream reader must derive 1-floor consistently with 1-raw_cosine), and the denominator for pairs where either row has floor None (banked rows, composed row) is undefined.
